chunks: Zurārah narrated to me, from ʿAbd al-Malik, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
He said: He said: One like you is ruined while he has not performed an obligatory prayer that Allah has made obligatory.
He said: I said: What should I do?
He said: He said: Pray in congregation, meaning the Friday prayer.

key_terms.فَرَضَهَا: made it obligatory or prescribed it
key_terms.فَرِيضَةً: an obligatory religious duty mandated by Allah
key_terms.يَهْلِكُ: is ruined or perishes, indicating grave loss for neglect

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the obligation of salat al-jumuʿah (Friday prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith stresses the seriousness of neglecting an obligatory prayer established by Allah. It directs the believers to perform the prayer in congregation, specifically referring here to salat al-jumuʿah (Friday prayer), indicating its legal and communal importance.
